run_local_container_experiment: run the xmanager launcher to create a local experiment with redis and server containers
create_local_experiment: create an xmanager local experiment with a title for container-based workloads
package_containers: package redis and server containers as xmanager Packageable executables for local execution
define_job_group: define an xmanager JobGroup with linked server and redis jobs using docker options
configure_docker_options: configure docker ports and volume mounts for local container executors in xmanager jobs
